title: Evaluation of Cognitive Architectures for Cyber-Physical Production Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and comparing existing cognitive architectures (RAMI4.0, IIRA, 5C, Soar, ACT-R) in the context of Cyber-Physical Production Systems for Industrie 4.0. The requirements and evaluation criteria are derived from industrial use cases such as diagnosis, energy efficiency, and process control. There is no discussion, evaluation, or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component of the paper.
